# Apple Design Philosophy Skill for Muse

Apple's fluid-interface philosophy — drawn from the WWDC "Designing Fluid Interfaces" talks — distilled and translated for the web: kill latency, track the finger 1:1, keep every animation interruptible, use springs with velocity handoff, add rubber-banding at boundaries, and layer translucent materials with restraint. Describe your interface or paste your code, and Muse advises you as if it had studied those design talks with you. Honest caveat: the skill leans heavily on code (CSS/JS snippets and concrete spring values), so you'll get the most out of it if you build web interfaces. Discovered via skills.sh. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
